source: Independent verifier pass over the graph backfill (2026-10-08), cross-checked against the live files

entities.name: harness audit
entities.description: HARNESS-AUDIT.md - phase 0 read-only inventory of active config, instructions, agents, commands, skills, MCPs, and permissions. Stale in one respect: it records AGENTS.md symlinked from opencode-config, but the live symlink is /workspaces/Opencode/AGENTS.md

entities.name: description override gap
entities.description: graph-assemble.mjs sets a node description only at creation and fills blanks afterwards, so a wrong description cannot be corrected by adding a new episode - it can only be changed by editing the original episode, which the store's append-only contract forbids. No override map, no last-writer-wins, no superseded_by for descriptions
